description: Structural Damage Detection Dataset: Dynamic Response of Coupled Substructures is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Tim Vrtač. This dataset contains dynamic response measurements for Structural Health Monitoring (SHM), focusing on the detection and identification of damage in assembly products. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
